chunks: Safwan narrated from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:

I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about a man who performs Tamattu', then enters the state of Ihram for Hajj, and performs Tawaf and Sa'i before departing to Mina, so he said, 'There is no harm (in it).'

key_terms.الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ: Safa and Marwah (the two hills between which Sa'i is performed)
key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعُ: Performs Tamattu' (a type of Hajj combining Umrah and Hajj)
key_terms.يُهِلُّ بِالْحَجِّ: Enters the state of Ihram for Hajj

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform Tawaf and Sa'i before going to Mina in Hajj al-Tamattu'?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that performing Tawaf and Sa'i prior to the departure for Mina does not invalidate the Hajj of Tamattu', addressing potential concerns about ritual sequence. This ruling underscores the flexibility in the timing of core Hajj rites, distinguishing between the essential pillars and the recommended chronological order. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the validity of acts when performed with correct intention, even if the sequence deviates from the most common practice.
